risk_note: RV2 (content client read API; contract). GET /v1/app-versions/check (x-auth none, deletion_only accepted): the exact (X-Platform, X-Channel) app_versions row of the caller's app_id, no channel fallback, shaped as AppVersionCheck; malformed rows and missing rows are 50001 with a logged warning; X-Device-Id is only format-checked (the route is unsigned); whole-row reads through an optional AppVersionRowStore that shares content's 60 s row cache with the minimum-version read, ContentStore unchanged (F1-10b frozen tests implement it). Read-only, no funds. Codex implementation in 3 rounds (implementation, rebase conflict resolution with F1-10b / F1-02d, decision 12); the contract change (checkAppVersion leaves x-implementation planned; route-schemas.gen.ts regenerated) is the orchestrator's mechanical commit with Couli-Mechanical: contract-codegen (approvals 31). The rule-test kit was restructured by the Claude test author before the implementation (only *.int.test.ts imports @couli/db/testing; assertions unchanged). The kit's freshAppId() used a hyphen that the contract X-App-Id pattern ^[a-z0-9_]+$ rejects (every request 20001); the orchestrator changed it to an underscore in a test(spec) commit before the implementation (precedent F1-02c #22), assertions unchanged. After F1-02f merged, the orchestrator rebased this branch: content-public.module.ts was a union of two additive provider lists (merged by hand, re-reviewed in round 2) and route-schemas.gen.ts was regenerated. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
